data.title: 爱丽丝 · 和平峰会殿堂的领袖风采
data.description: 现实世界庄严肃穆的国际峰会讲台前，爱丽丝身穿深蓝与纯白交织的金色刺绣高定礼服，挺拔站立面向闪光灯，展现跨界领袖的从容与智慧。

data.promptProse: Addressing a grand modern international summit from behind a sleek podium, Alice looks out with commanding poise in her royal blue and gold embroidered ambassador gown.
data.animaCaption: Alice addressing an international summit with regal diplomatic grace. The hall lighting clearly reveals her face, podium and conference room.
